packageRules.description: Keep create-frontend's BurgerEditor packages on v3 — they are copied into generated baserCMS projects, whose block markup (bge-blocks-v2.html) targets BurgerEditor v3; v4 is used only by the static type via @d-zero/scaffold and the two majors never coexist in one project

Group site-migrator puppeteer with @d-zero/anatomist so a version bump on either side prefers landing together in one PR — site-migrator launches puppeteer itself and passes the resulting Page across the package boundary into anatomist analyzePageLayout(), and the two must resolve the same puppeteer-core install or TypeScript rejects the Page argument as structurally incompatible (TS2345)
